title: Accounts Executive
summary: Accounts executives keep a company's day-to-day books: they post entries in Tally or an ERP, pay vendors, track customer receipts and reconcile bank and party ledgers. They sit in the accounts team under the accounts manager and also prepare GST and TDS returns and support month-end close and audits.
dailyDuties: Post purchase, sales and journal vouchers in Tally or the ERP
Process vendor invoices and schedule payments
Reconcile bank, vendor and customer ledgers
Prepare GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B data and reconcile GSTR-2B
Calculate TDS, pay challans and file quarterly returns
Pass month-end accruals and prepare schedules for audit

skills.expectation: Keep books, pass journal entries and support month-end close
Prepare GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, calculate TDS and file returns on time
Post vouchers in Tally Prime or a similar accounting package
Process vendor invoices and payments and follow up customer receipts
Reconcile bank, vendor and customer ledgers every month
Keep schedules and reconciliations in Excel
Prepare audit schedules and answer first-level auditor queries
Use pivot tables and VLOOKUP to match large ledgers
Follow up clearly with vendors, customers and auditors
